item.title: Increased Investigation Volume [resolved]
item.description:
We have contacted all affected customers via email or their account teams and shared remediation plans for investigations created during the affected window. Our engineering teams have also begun the cleanup process.
Please note: We are transitioning to direct updates for impacted customers, and this status page will no longer be updated. If you believe you were affected but have not received communication, please contact Rapid7 Support or reach out to your account team.

item.description: This incident has now been resolved.

item.title: Monitoring a Vendor Outage in me-central-01 [resolved]
item.description: Update – We continue to monitor the vendor outage impacting the me-central-01 region. At this time, affected services remain unavailable and we do not have an estimated timeline for full restoration. We have completed dedicated outreach to impacted customers via email and/or through their account teams to ensure visibility and support. As this issue is driven by a vendor, we will transition to a dedicated update format. As a result this status page will no longer reflect our current state. If you believe you were impacted and have not received direct communication, please contact Rapid7 Support or reach out to your account team for assistance. We appreciate your continued patience as we work with our vendor to resolve this issue.
